integration.strategy: Candidate source is frozen after version, public-document, publication-scope and non-functional lint updates.

sdist_normalization.command_contract: Normalize each fresh raw sdist to a new external path with this source-bound script and epoch; compare normalized bytes, not gzip metadata.

candidate_execution_profile.source_materialization: Selected regular Git blobs from source_sha only; no working-tree source bytes.
candidate_execution_profile.build_command: Set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH to the contract epoch; python scripts/verify_public_package.py --root . --contract qualification/0_2_12/wp13_candidate_build_contract_20261031_v3.json --output <new-external-output>
candidate_execution_profile.reproducibility: Two independent fresh external output directories; compare exact wheel bytes and normalized sdist bytes. No prior candidate artifact reuse.
archive_checks: regular files and safe portable paths only
reject undeclared payloads, aliases, symlinks and unexpected files
verify package version and distribution metadata
twine check on exact wheel and raw/normalized sdist
installed_probes: contract runner: separate no-index/no-deps install of exact wheel and installed import/CLI/refusal probes
independent fresh sdist installation from the exact candidate sdist and installed source-hash/import/CLI/refusal probes
dependency-resolving installation from the local wheel and local sdist in separate clean environments
non-solving check-mesh probes on TET4, BEAM2 and MITC4 examples only; no assembly or structural solve
candidate_execution_profile.evidence_output: New external output directories only; preserve source mapping, command records, environment, archive checks, installed probes and hashes.

limitations: This contract authorizes selected candidate build and bounded scans only; it does not authorize a tag, main merge, GitHub Release, PyPI upload, Zenodo deposit, DOI assignment, ledger update or maturity promotion.
The selected scope does not scan or clear the full repository or Git history; G03 remains FAIL_PRESERVED and the whole-repository archive remains uncleared.
No structural solves or FEM campaigns are authorized or executed by this candidate build contract.
Full directory-wide unit/integration and coverage suites are not represented by targeted node results.
Only the Windows Python versions listed in execution results are locally verified; no Linux runtime result is inferred.
owner_authorization: WP13 Owner directive authorizes bounded candidate build and verification only; publication, tag creation, main merge and site synchronization are not authorized.

This prospective revision excludes internal engineering and audit reports from the served site while preserving their Git files, and revises the public qualification page to identify the historical source snapshot. The failed v2 scan remains archived.
